correctness.rationale: PASS: For every field K and nonzero (u,v), expansion of the Nijenhuis torsion of N=[[a,b],[c,d]] for the bilinear bracket mu(e2,e1)=u e1 and mu(e2,e2)=v e1 gives uc²=vc²=0 and, after c=0, (a-d)(v(a-d)-ub)=0. The Leibniz identity follows directly from mu(x,y)=x2(uy1+vy2)e1. Projectively [0:1] produces only P0={aI+bE12}, while [1:t] produces P0 union {c=0,b=t(a-d)} meeting on scalars. Pairwise intersection is P0, a dual-number algebra. For F_q the plane ranks and inclusion-exclusion give exceptional q², generic 2q²-q and 2q³ projective incidence; repeated over F_(q^m) this yields the reduced point-count zeta 1/(1-q³ T)². Independent symbolic torsion derivation recovered all nonzero components and independently exhaustively counted every projective fiber over F2, F3 and F5, verifying rank strata and total 2q³; these finite checks are not used to prove the arbitrary-field result.
